verdict: Prismatic Evolutions has held value better since release: PRIS25 70.82 (Sep 28 mark, 100 = Jan 2025) vs SSP24 66.00 (Oct 4 mark, 100 = Nov 2024); −29.2% in ~20 months vs −34.0% in ~23. Same calendar months Jan 2025→Jul 2026 (monthly reconstruction): −19.1% vs −32.8%. Top three sold-comp medians $1,820.49 vs $502.80. Surging Sparks is the cheaper entry: ETB lowest ask $114.95 (9 live) vs $129.99 (26), bundle $54.99 (33) vs $74.00 (27), Oct 5. Caveat on page: chase index (49) vs full-set capped index (249).
